mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( password, email, phone, postcode, nick_name, first_name, last_name, avatar, permission ) VALUES ( #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{postcode}, #{nickName}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{avatar}, #{permission} )
mapper.select: SELECT userId, email, phone, postcode, nick_name AS nickName, first_name AS firstName, last_name AS lastName, avatar, permission FROM users WHERE userId = #{userId}
